resources.string: Below the threshold (not charging) the video plays at a lower resolution and at most 30 fps. The full quality is back 5 % above it or on the charger (unless battery saver keeps it, see below). A quality you pick in the player wins until the next video. Also in the Shorts feed; not for downloads (they have only one quality). With 720p, 60 fps videos play at 480p: their 720p exists only at 60 fps.
Lower the quality while the system\'s battery saver is on, whatever the battery level, on the charger too.
At 20, 15, 10 and 5 % the video moves in briefly and shows the level\'s colour around it, with a vibration of its own per level (only with \"Custom haptics\" on).
